t: Easy self-drilling plug with cross-drive recess can be drilled straight into plasterboard. No special setting tool required. Supplied with screws and drill bit. Sharp, self-tapping thread enables a secure, positive fit fixing and achieves a high load-bearing capacity. Can hold wood, sheet metal and chipboard screws from 4 to 5mm thickness as well as different hooks and eye screws. Universally suitable for fixing lights, electrical installations and fitting accessories securely and quickly.
b: Suitable for Installing Electrical Boxes & Light Switches
